learning_outcomes.text: Ability to design and execute an experiment in engineering
Ability to formulate an experimental problem
Ability to analyze the object under investigation
Ability to analyze available means for execution of an experiment
Ability to design the ideal model of an experiment
Ability to design the experimental model of an experiment
Ability to design and solve the analytical model of an experiment
Ability to infer conclusions for the model of a system
Ability to infer conclusions for the behavior of the real system
Ability to analyze data in the Matlab environment
Ability to present the results of an experiment

syllabus_topics: Research project. Population and sample, Deduction and induction, A Characteristic, Design of a research project, Data acquisition, Interpretation of the results
Probability theory - an introduction. Rules of probability, Bayes theorem, ROC curve, Odds, probability, likelihood

Probability distribution. Discrete and continuous random variable, Probability and relative frequency, Normal distribution, Binomial distribution, Poisson distribution, Sample and descriptive statistics, Measures of central tendency, Mean, modus, median, Measures of variation, Range, Variation, Standard deviation, Quantiles
Estimates of probability, Distribution of a sample mean, Interval estimate of a mean, Sample size
Hypothesis testing. Null and alternative hypothesis, The type I. and II. errors
Two samples comparison. Mean comparison, Pair comparison
Non-parametric methods. Quantile, median and sign tests, Wilcoxon's pair test, Mann-Whitney's test
Nominal data. Chi-square test, Contingency tables
Linear regression and correlation
Analysis of variance. Mean comparison for 3+ groups, Model condition verification, Multiple comparison

Visualising a random process. Random numbers generation, Creating a plot, Computation of the probability of random processes, Conditional probability computation, Testing the dependence of random processes, Calculating probabilities using Bayes' theorem (Matlab)
Calculation of the sensitivity and selectivity of a test. Construction of the ROC curve (Matlab)
Calculation of odds, probabilities and likelihoods
Construction of the probability distribution function and the distribution function for discrete and continuous random variable (Matlab)
Visualising the probability density. Calculating probabilities (Matlab)
Calculation of the descriptive characteristics. Plotting the histogram, the percentile plot, box plot, normal plot (Matlab)
Visualising the probability distribution of the sample mean (Matlab)

Hypothesis testing. Carrying out one sample t-test, two sample t-test, comparison of the population probabilities, Evaluation of the pair measurement, Carrying out non-parametric tests, quantile test, median test, sign test, Wilcoxon's test, Mann-Whitney's test
Categorial data. Carrying out chi-square test, Evaluation of the contingency table (Matlab)
Carrying out linear regression and correlation (Matlab)
Carrying out analysis of variance
Execution of an experiment
Presentation of the results of the experiment
